meta.purpose: Decide WHAT IS BEING READ. This process seeds candidate spans, screens them for inner-being relevance, assigns each a role, and maintains the ib_characteristic registry. It is the study's gatekeeper: a span that gets past Screen 0 wrongly poisons every layer above it.
meta.the_hard_part: Almost every rule here is [I]. Screen 0 and role assignment are two of only a handful of genuinely interpretive judgements in the whole application (plan §4) — they cannot be derived from morphology, because whether a verse is about the human inner being is a question about MEANING. This file is therefore the opposite of raw.json: the gates cannot do the work, they can only catch the errors.
meta.envelope: Every item carries the common rule envelope — see ../_manifest.json meta.envelope.

the_scaffolding_warning.ruling: plan §1.4 'resists over-structuring' — clusters/characteristics remain DISPOSABLE SCAFFOLDING and the software treats them as such.
the_scaffolding_warning.why: Over-structuring an integrated subject is named as THE DEEPEST ROOT of six months of failure: the impulse to impose tidy structure on human inner life, which is not systemisable. The organising unit was rebuilt 4-5 times (registry -> dimension -> term-similarity -> characteristic -> movements), each reset turning prior 'completed' work into legacy.
the_scaffolding_warning.consequence_for_this_file: A characteristic is a HANDLE for finding evidence, not a claim about reality. Nothing downstream may depend on the characteristic set being stable, correct, or exhaustive. If this file's structures start looking authoritative, that is the failure recurring.
the_scaffolding_warning.the_object: The real object is a focus point — latent, emergent, dynamic; never observed directly, only INFERRED from the operations a verse describes. The characteristic list VALIDATES (verse -> list), it never IMPUTES (list -> verse).

open.issue: The role vocabulary is contested across FOUR sources (recon.role-enum): catalogue §8, cycle §1, integrity/readiness, success-criteria — and `qualifier` was retired 2026-07-07 then reinstated 2026-07-12.
open.consequence: `ent.char.role` is RECONCILE, so THE LOADER WILL NOT RUN THIS PROCESS. Role is also D115, so the lexical process is blocked on the same decision.
open.recommendation: The filed recommendation stands: `characteristic · qualifier · standalone · uncertain`, with alias_map {process-qualifier -> qualifier, undecided -> uncertain}.

open.issue: `gate.char.screen0` is [I] — but Screen 0 is the judgement that decides the study's object, and the 07-14 audit found it failing in live data (Pro 8:28 'God made firm the skies' roled `characteristic`, with God as bearer).
open.consequence: The gate that guards the study's boundary is enforced by the same faculty that breached it. A model judging its own Screen-0 call is the self-certification this design forbids.
options: A: independent [I] verifier — a second call, prompted adversarially ('refute that this is the human inner being'), never the producing call
B: [C] pre-filter (bearer != God is partly morphological — a divine-name subject is detectable) + [I] verify the remainder
open.recommendation: B + A. The bearer!=God case that actually failed IS partly mechanical — a divine-name subject with a human-inner-being predicate is detectable, and would have caught Pro 8:28. Then adversarially verify what survives.

open.issue: Characteristics are ruled DISPOSABLE SCAFFOLDING, yet ib_characteristic is a persisted, keyed registry that findings will reference.
open.consequence: A persisted key invites exactly the dependence the disposability rule forbids — and re-keying then breaks everything referencing it. This tension caused prior resets.
options: A: findings bind to SPANS (immutable), never to characteristic ids; the characteristic is a query over spans, re-derivable and freely re-cuttable
B: findings bind to characteristic ids; re-keying is a migration
C: both — a span binding (authoritative) + a characteristic id (convenience, rebuildable)
open.recommendation: A. It is the only option that makes disposability real rather than aspirational: if nothing durable references a characteristic id, the set can be re-cut at will — which the method demands, since patterns must EMERGE. Also matches 'the span-id is the join key' (plan §3.4.2).
open.resolve_by: researcher decision — architecturally significant; affects the findings process and Appendix B

open.issue: The seed is deliberately over-inclusive and non-exhaustive — Screen 0 then rejects. But there is no rule for what over-inclusive MEANS, so the seed's breadth is a judgement made per run.
open.consequence: Seed breadth silently sets the study's coverage. Too narrow and the inner being is understated — which is precisely what the two prior ~100-page studies did, and the quality bar this programme measures itself against.
open.recommendation: Bias to over-inclusion and let Screen 0 carry the cost. A false positive is caught by a gate; a false negative is invisible forever. State this as a rule with a measurable seed-recall check.
open.moved_to: process/base.json — the seed lives there now

process.intent: The first question asked of every candidate span, before any other work: is this the HUMAN inner being? Everything downstream assumes this was answered correctly.
process.satisfaction: Every span that proceeds is about the human inner being. God's own attribute or action is the ARENA, never the object.

process.intent: The governing method of the entire programme. A focus point is latent and can never be observed directly — only inferred from the operations a verse describes it performing.
process.satisfaction: Every characteristic is read BACKWARD from the act: this happened, what inner reality produced it? Never forward from lexical surface.

spec.statement: Infer, don't extract. Read the verse BACKWARD (this act happened -> what inner reality produced it?), never FORWARD (this word appears -> log its category).
spec.why: The inner being is not a grouping of distinct phenomena but an interrelated network of operations behaving dynamically under influences, triggers and effects. A forward read can only ever find the words; the object is what the words imply.

process.intent: Protect the finding from the tidying instinct. Two occurrences of a word are not one thing seen twice — the DIFFERENCE between them is the discovery.
process.satisfaction: Repeated spans keep their distinctions. Grouping is resisted, not defaulted to.

spec.statement: RESIST grouping. The DIFFERENCE between repeated spans IS the finding.
spec.why: This is over-structuring in miniature — and over-structuring is the deepest named root. Every grouping is a small claim that the subject is systemisable.
